jobs.title: Senior Manager Growth - Europe
jobs.description: Iterative Health is a healthcare technology and services company powering the acceleration of clinical research to transform patient outcomes. We built a leading performance-driven network of 100+ sites across the US, Europe, India, and Australia, conducting research directly in the communities where care is delivered across gastrointestinal, hepatology, obesity, and cardiology. By combining deep clinical trial expertise with cutting-edge AI, we connect sponsors scientific ambitions with high-performing research teams that expedite and expand access to novel therapeutics for patients in need. Today, Iterative Health is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and New York City with 250+ employees world-wide.   As Senior Manager of Growth for Europe, you will be a key strategic partner to the European leadership team helping drive the projects, initiatives, and growth agenda that shape how Iterative Health expands across the region.  This is a role at the intersection of strategy and execution: you will translate ambitious goals into structured plans, and then make sure those plans get delivered. You will work across a broad range of workstreams — from strategic planning and market development to M&A support and cross-functional project coordination.  The common thread is operating as a trusted, high-quality partner to leadership: someone who can pick up a complex topic, structure it clearly, drive it forward, and ensure the right people are aligned and moving. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical foundations, a genuine interest in healthcare and clinical research, and the drive to build something meaningful in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.  Fluency in English and Polish required. Location : Warsaw, Poland or Munich, Germany Employment Type: Full-Time EOR Strategic Projects & Execution Work closely with the European leadership team to identify, structure, and prioritize the key strategic initiatives that drive IH s grow

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is a non-profit-backed technology company that has helped shape the internet for the better over the past 25 years. We’re the makers of Firefox , the privacy-focused web browser used by more than 225 million people around the world each month. As we look to the future, we’re working to shape the next 25 years of the internet—one that’s built for people, not just for profit. Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the 501(c) non-profit Mozilla Foundation , meaning we’re accountable not to shareholders, but to our mission. Alongside thousands of contributors and collaborators around the world, Mozillians design, build, and maintain open-source software that empowers people to use the internet on their own terms. We’re now seeking a Senior Solutions Engineer (DACH) to support the growth of Firefox Enterprise across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. This is a highly customer-facing technical role focused on helping enterprises evaluate, validate, and deploy Firefox Enterprise in secure, complex, and regulated environments. The ideal candidate brings deep technical credibility, strong enterprise architecture experience, and a passion for helping customers solve real-world security, deployment, and interoperability challenges. What you ll do: Partner with Sales to support strategic enterprise opportunities across DACH. Lead technical discovery and solution design with customers and partners. Run workshops with customer stakeholders across security, infrastructure, IAM, endpoint management, and workplace technology. Own the relationship to the customer’s technical counterparts during and after the sales process.  Help customers evaluate Firefox Enterprise in areas such as deployment, policy management, identity integration, logging, security controls, and operational fit. jobs.description: Job Responsibilities Deploy, configure, update, and maintain software applications and services on Linux-based robotic devices. Troubleshoot software and system issues, including service failures, resource usage problems, and network connectivity issues. Develop Shell or Python scripts to automate software deployment and routine maintenance tasks. Support OTA software updates, remote device maintenance, and troubleshooting of upgrade failures. Basic understanding of TCP/IP, SSH, and Linux networking. Good problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively with R&D teams. Chinese and English are the working languages; good working proficiency in both is required. Preferred Qualifications Experience with robotic systems, embedded Linux, or other smart devices. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity
jobs.description: About the team: The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp. We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success. As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter. We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users. What you'll do: Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems. Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users. Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers. Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact prefer

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity
jobs.description: About the team: The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp. We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team s success. As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp s identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you ll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn t required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter. We re looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You ll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You ll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.   What you’ll do: Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems. Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users. Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers. Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact

jobs.title: Senior Program & Partnerships Manager - Autonomous Vehicle
jobs.description: Location : Berlin, Barcelona or London! At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. The autonomous transition is a transformational opportunity for Lyft. Our strategy focuses on becoming the preferred marketplace, fleet, and operational partner for the world s best Autonomous Vehicle (AV) providers. As AV services begin launching across Europe, the programs that govern our partnerships, from pre-launch planning through ongoing operations, become a critical foundation for sustainable growth. This role sits at the center of that work, owning the end-to-end management of our autonomous partnership programs and serving as the primary face of Lyft to our external partners. You have experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with external partners or customers. You are a skilled communicator who can represent Lyft externally with credibility and care, while bringing together a wide range of internal teams. You enjoy combining strategic relationship management with hands-on operational rigor, and you know how to stay close to the details without losing sight of the bigger picture. Wir sichern die Primärversorgung in der Fläche, mit Hausarzt- und Diabeteszentren und der Migräne- und Kopfschmerzklinik Königstein. Sie verantworten unsere Buchhaltung eigenständig und begleiten die Jahresabschlüsse mit unserer Steuerkanzlei. Auf einen Blick Eintritt: Frühjahr oder Sommer 2027 Umfang: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (ab ca. 30 Std./Woche) Arbeitsort: Frankfurt am Main oder Königstein im Taunus, hybrid Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr (Vollzeit), Teilzeit anteilig Ihre Aufgaben Sie führen die Finanzbuchhaltung eigenständig: Kreditoren, Debitoren, Bank und Anlagenbuchhaltung. Sie erstellen Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldungen und Monatsabschlüsse. Sie bereiten die Jahresabschlüsse vor und begleiten sie gemeinsam mit unserer Steuerkanzlei. Sie stimmen Konten ab, pflegen Verrechnungen innerhalb der Gruppe und liefern Zahlen für unser Reporting. Sie entwickeln Abläufe weiter, etwa digitale Belegprozesse und Automatisierung. Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung und in der Vorbereitung von Jahresabschlüssen, in einer Kanzlei oder einem Unternehmen. Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV und Excel. Erfahrung in der Lohnabrechnung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Sie arbeiten selbstständig und genau und behalten auch bei mehreren Gesellschaften den Überblick. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Was wir bieten 52.000–62.000 € brutto im Jahr (Vollzeit), Teilzeit anteilig. Hybrides Arbeiten: Präsenz in Frankfurt oder Königstein, der Rest mobil. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Voll- oder Teilzeit.

jobs.title: AI Modelling and Simulation Engineer
jobs.description: The Opportunity Lumai is moving from optical-compute research into production AI systems, and the architecture and compiler decisions that shape the product are being made now, ahead of the silicon that will confirm them. This hire builds the modelling capability those decisions rest on. The Role You will own the performance and power modelling framework that predicts how Lumai's photonic AI hardware performs against real inference workloads, giving the architecture and compiler teams one shared source of truth for latency, throughput and power across device configurations. You will model the compute engines, interconnect, memory and bridge interfaces; keep the model honest by characterising operator-level workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results; and turn what the model says into decisions teams act on. What is genuinely hard about this is balancing speed, fidelity and usability. The model has to capture concurrency, event-driven behaviour and compute-block latency in enough detail to support real architecture decisions, and still compare configurations in minutes rather than overnight. The gap between what the model predicts and what the hardware does has to be measured rather than assumed, and closing it is the part that never stops. What You'll Do Design, build and maintain a Python-based framework that models hardware and software latency, hardware concurrency and event-driven relationships. Model compute engines, interconnect and synchronisation fabric, memory and bridge interfaces, and accelerator blocks across device configurations. Characterise convolution, depthwise convolution, pooling, attention and other operator workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results. Build compiler-agnostic interfaces that ingest compiled models and MLIR from multiple internal compiler flows. jobs.description: Why Numeric Every business runs on accounting, but the systems underneath it were built for a different era. Today’s ERPs don’t store a company’s financial data. They store a diluted copy of it. Every contract, lease, and invoice gets flattened into a journal entry, and the context that made it meaningful is thrown away. That’s why accounting teams spend every month re-checking numbers, stitching together spreadsheets, and waiting on engineering, and why AI struggles to do real accounting work. Accounting doesn’t have a reporting problem. It has a data problem. Enter Numeric: the data platform finance teams run on. We started with the month-end close, where the data problem hurts most, and hundreds of finance teams now run their close on Numeric. That work led us to rebuild the system of record itself. In September 2026 we launched the Financial Data Platform (FDP) , a platform built for the agent era. Instead of a journal entry, the real business object enters the system and the accounting is derived from it. Every number is traceable to its source, reporting works on any dimension, and accountants and AI agents finally have enough context to work together. While others bolted AI features onto the old data model, we built a new one. We have a growing base of customers who love our product, including Anthropic, Plaid, Brex, Betterment, Wealthfront, and Asana. We’ve raised $89M from top-tier investors including IVP, Menlo Ventures, Founders Fund, and 8VC, along with founders and executives from Ramp, Segment, and other category-defining companies. Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. We are looking for a hands-on Head of Platform / Senior Platform Manager to own the architecture, automation and operation of our secure infrastructure capability. You will solve a distinctive engineering challenge: enabling customers to deploy, operate, monitor and recover our platform independently, including in environments where UFORCE has no direct access to systems. You will combine deep technical execution with platform leadership, establishing repeatable deployment patterns today and helping shape the team as the function grows. What You'll Do Design and deliver secure, repeatable infrastructure for air-gapped, on-premise, customer-hosted and cloud environments. Build infrastructure-as-code capable of standing up isolated environments reliably on reference hardware. Provision and operate Kubernetes across cloud and bare-metal infrastructure. Develop automated configuration, deployment, upgrade and recovery processes. Create platforms that customers can install, monitor, maintain and troubleshoot independently. Own core infrastructure foundations across identity, networking, compute, storage, secrets, CI/CD and observability. Translate security, assurance and accreditation requirements into automated, auditable platform controls. Establish service ownership, SLOs, incident response, problem management and resilience practices. Partner with Security, Product and Delivery team

Develop active-learning loops that prioritize the highest-value frames for limited operator review. Build reproducible train/eval pipelines with experiment tracking, model packaging, and promotion gates. jobs.description: LOCATION: King’s Cross, London · PATTERN: Hybrid, with regular time in the lab The opportunity We’re a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You’d help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders. This role builds our analysis from the start. Every result leaves an instrument as a trace or a vendor file, and it has to become a value someone can rely on, linked back to the sequence and sample it came from. That means fitting it properly, checking it against controls, catching the plate or reagent lot that drifted, and showing the evidence. Someone has to own that work. That is this role. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn’t exist yet, so we’re building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We’re in stealth and heads-down on execution. We’ll share more about what we’re building once you’ve spoken with the team. The role You will join the intelligence team and own the analysis of our assay data, and the data and ML infrastructure it runs on, from the point the data has been captured to the result that gets delivered. You will work most closely with the protein characterisation scientists who run the assays, and with the software team, who get data out of the instruments and own the platform it lives on. You build on top of that platform, and you own the quality of the analysis that runs on it. The role is part data engineer and part biostatistician, and all of the data is biological. Much of it is building the analysis and ML pipelines that run on our captured data, and the statistics inside them. The rest is presenting those results clearly, with the statistics that matter, such as uncertainty and QC, shown in a form they can understand. jobs.title: Growth Lead
jobs.description: About Nous Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute. We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money. We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked. Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent. And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. jobs.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. About the role Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof. You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship. Why now Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it. The problem you're solving Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal. We have the underlying technology to change that. jobs.title: Ingénieur ou post-doctorant pour l'analyse des données acquises par un radar HF océanographique couvrant le Raz Blanchard
jobs.company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
jobs.description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’UFR S2I sur le Campus de Brest. Projet FLOWATT Le projet FLOWATT, dans le cadre duquel s’inscrit cette étude, vise à déployer et exploiter six hydroliennes dans les forts courants marins du Raz Blanchard, en Normandie. Au-delà de la production d’énergie, FLOWATT a pour objectif d’évaluer le potentiel du Raz Blanchard pour le déploiement de fermes hydroliennes à plus grande échelle. Cette évaluation repose notamment sur une caractérisation précise de la ressource, une estimation fine du productible et une meilleure compréhension des impacts environnementaux. Pour répondre à ces enjeux, le projet combine mesures in situ, modélisation numérique et essais expérimentaux afin de fournir les connaissances nécessaires à la préparation des futurs déploiements commerciaux, tout en contribuant à la réduction des coûts de production et à la limitation des impacts sur l’environnement marin. Dans ce contexte, la caractérisation de l’état de mer constitue un enjeu important, notamment dans une zone soumise à des courants très intenses. La présente étude s’intéresse ainsi aux données de radar HF acquises depuis fin 2017, ainsi qu’à celles qui seront nouvelle

Developed in-house, our innovative software makes millions of trading decisions daily, and we win by making better and faster decisions than our competition. Onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning, access management and device setup. Troubleshooting, escalating and documenting network and connectivity issues. Automating repetitive tasks and keeping knowledge base articles and runbooks in Confluence up to date. Organizing and performing desk moves, room setups and physical equipment moves. Everything else that keeps us moving. Your Skills and Experience A degree in an ICT-related field

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases. You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation. What You'll Work On Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites. jobs.description: About the team Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives. Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment. The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control. You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk. What you'll do You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. We zoeken een Senior HR Business Partner die ons team door een verandertraject begeleidt en adviseert. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Lefebvre Sdu transformeert van uitgever naar techbedrijf. De mensen die hier werken bouwen het platform waarop onze AI-revolutie draait, en ze doen dat terwijl de organisatie om hen heen verandert. 70 mensen nu, vacatures open, en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. jobs.description: Brief info about Vinted  Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we re looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. The team consists exclusively of experienced backend engineers, ensuring you always have someone to discuss your ideas with. jobs.description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this." You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt. That’s where we come in. The Customs Technology team at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing. jobs.description: The challenge An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal. These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale the Calling for Work product proposition from 1 to 100. There's no mature roadmap to inherit: you'll write it, test it with customers and scale what works, with our Product & Tech team, to deliver a step change in segment growth. What you’ll do Own the product proposition: Set the vision, strategy, roadmap and targets for Calling for Work, and be responsible for its user growth and retention. Shape the business proposition: Define what Talk360's business offer is and how it's priced, together with our commercial teams. Learn from customers continuously: Use interviews, surveys, support tickets and app store reviews to turn pains into a ranked opportunity roadmap. Experiment fast: Ship small bets, A/B test the journeys that matter, observe real world behaviour and turn results into roadmap decisions. jobs.title: Account Executive Tender (Non-profit) & RFPs
jobs.description: In de non-profit-, overheid- en onderwijswereld draait alles om impact en vertrouwen. Het proces is gestructureerd en verloopt stap voor stap, maar tenders zijn complex en relaties zijn cruciaal. Zo'n 30% van onze commerciële inflow komt binnen via tenders en RFPs — en dat aandeel groeit. RFPs komen daarbij vaak van grotere enterprise-klanten en worden in samenwerking met andere Account Executives voorbereid en opgepakt. Veel salesmensen begrijpen dat proces onvoldoende. Ze sturen standaardproposities en hopen op het beste. Wij geloven dat het anders moet: met echte gesprekken, diep begrip van aanbestedingsdynamiek en een adviseur die meedenkt in het PvE-proces in plaats van alleen reageert op een uitvraag. Route harnesses through rotating joints and moving axes: select flex- and torsion-rated cables and drive cable life tests together with mechanical engineering. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Server Infrastructure)
jobs.description: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The Role Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Almost every Nebius service runs on servers within our domain. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible. We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer - Voice & Chatbots (m/w/d) - Remote
jobs.description: Diese Position ist für unsere Gesellschaft Medialine Communications GmbH zu besetzen. Die Medialine Communications GmbH ist ein etabliertes ITK- und Kommunikationsunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Berlin. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden mit leistungsstarken Lösungen in den Bereichen IT-Services, Kommunikation und Managed Services. Wir planen und betreiben Kommunikationslösungen für mittelständische Unternehmen und Konzerne, von Teams-Telefonie und SBC-Infrastruktur bis zu KI-gestützten Voice- und Chatbots. Für unser wachsendes KI-Portfolio suchen wir jemanden, der Kunden nicht nur berät, sondern die Lösung auch selbst mit umsetzt. Deine Aufgaben Kundenanforderungen in Bot-Lösungen übersetzen: Du entwickelst aus Service- und Hotline-Prozessen intelligente Voice- und Chatbot-Szenarien. Technische Konzepte und Demos erstellen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, erstellst Architekturen, unterstützt den Vertrieb und entwickelst Proof of Concepts. Voice- und Chatbots implementieren: Du setzt moderne KI-Lösungen inklusive Prompt-Design, Gesprächslogik und Wissensdatenbanken um. Systeme integrieren: Du bindest CRM-, E-Mail-, Kalender- und Ticketsysteme über APIs, Webhooks sowie Tools wie n8n oder Power Automate an. Telefonie und Kommunikation anbinden: Du koordinierst die Integration von SIP-, VoIP- und Telefonielösungen mit Kunden und internen Teams. Lösungen testen und optimieren: Du begleitest Pilotphasen, analysierst Ergebnisse und entwickelst die Bots kontinuierlich weiter. Dokumentation und Übergabe sichern: Du dokumentierst Projekte nachvollziehbar und übergibst Lösungen erfolgreich in den Betrieb. Dein Profil Technischer Hintergrund: Studium, Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im IT-Umfeld. Erfahrung in Beratung und Umsetzung: Du bringst Projekt- und Implementierungserfahrung im IT- oder Kommunikationsumfeld mit. Kenntnisse in KI und Automatisierung: Erfahrung mit Voice-/Chatbots, LLMs, Prompt-Design sowie APIs und Workflow-Tools. Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst technische

You’ll work directly with regulatory affairs teams at pharma and MedTech customers to turn their needs into a clear roadmap and make sure coverage, data quality, and reliability stay high. jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (TypeScript, Full-Stack)
jobs.description: REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands. We turn hundreds of pages of complex regulations, like MDR and FDA guidance, into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers' development and quality processes. We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A. About the job As a Senior Product Engineer, you'll build the product our customers use every day: requirements formulation, document comparison, compliance checks against internal SOPs, and the AI agents that work alongside regulatory and quality experts. Product thinking is as important here as engineering execution. jobs.description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.
